  • {{Season|all}} (other) |edibility = -20 |sellprice = 75 |xp = *Foraging: 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] *The Farm Cave: 5 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] *Mushroom Trees: 0 }} The '''Red Mushroom''' is a type of mushroom obtainable by: * [[Foraging]] in [[the Mines]] on [[The Mines#The Mushroom Floor|Mushroom Floors]] (starting at floor 81). * Found on levels 21-69 of the Mines while the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] is enabled, or the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger in The Deep]] quest is active. * In the [[Secret Woods]] during [[Summer]] and (more rarely) [[Fall]]. * In the [[Farm Maps|Forest Farm]] during Fall. * Inside of the [[Ginger Island#Dig Site|Ginger Island mushroom cave]]. * Searching [[Garbage Can]]s during any season. * Collected from the mushroom bins in [[the Cave]] if the mushroom option was chosen. * By [[Tapper|tapping]] a [[Mushroom Tree]]. * Collected from a [[Mushroom Log]]. * By cutting down a Mushroom Tree with the [[Forge#Tool enchantments|Shaving]] enchantment. * Purchased at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|75}}. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |hate=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus |dislike=Penny }} ==Bundles== *Red Mushroom is used in the {{Bundle|Dye||y}}. *Red Mushroom is one of the options for the {{Bundle|Exotic||y}}. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Life Elixir|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Red Mushroom is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Spotted Headscarf|class=inline}}. It can also be used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, located at [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *The Red Mushroom may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|225}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. *2-3 Red Mushrooms may be requested by [[Catfish]], [[Spook Fish]], or [[Woodskip]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].
